title: Take a firewall change from request to closed
scenario: The network team wants to replace a firewall rule that permits a legacy payroll application with a narrower one. Put the change management steps in the order a controlled change follows. The order is the point: a change approved before it was tested, or a backout plan written after the window opened, is the failure change management exists to prevent.
requirements: Partial credit applies per step, so place every one even where you are unsure.

items.label: Implement the change inside the maintenance window
Change approval board reviews the request and approves it
Update the network diagram, the procedure and version control
Analyse the impact: which systems and users depend on the old rule
Write the backout plan to restore the old rule
Test the new rule in a non-production environment and record the results
Tell the affected stakeholders when the window is and what to expect

subtasks.label: Impact analysis first
subtasks.correctNote: You cannot test, plan a rollback for, or approve a change whose dependencies you have not identified. Impact analysis is what tells you what could break.

subtasks.label: Testing second
subtasks.correctNote: Test results are evidence the approvers need. Approving first means deciding on a guess.

subtasks.label: Backout plan before approval
subtasks.correctNote: Approvers need to see how the change is undone before they authorise it. A backout plan written after the window opens is written under pressure.

subtasks.label: Approval fourth
subtasks.correctNote: Approval authorises the change on the strength of the impact analysis, test results and backout plan. It is a gate that everything before it feeds.

subtasks.label: Stakeholders told before the work
subtasks.correctNote: Stakeholders are informed so they can plan for the downtime. Telling them afterwards is an apology, not a notification.

subtasks.label: Implementation in the window
subtasks.correctNote: The change is made only after approval, inside the agreed maintenance window, to the written plan.

subtasks.label: Documentation updated last
subtasks.correctNote: Diagrams, procedures and version control are updated to describe what is now true. Updating them earlier records a state that does not yet exist.
